turns.customer: I'm thinking of daycare for my pup Ollie about twice a week, ongoing. What are my options and what's cheapest per day?
blocks:
For **Ollie at about twice a week**, the closest fit is the **2-visits-per-week membership**: **$300/month**, with 10 visits listed per month—about **$30 per visit**.

| Option | Listed price | Approx. cost per day |
|---|---:|---:|
| Single full-day visit | $36 | $36 |
| 10-day prepaid pack | $350 | $35 |
| 20-day prepaid pack | $680 | $34 |
| Membership, 1 visit/week (5/month) | $160/month | $32 |
| **Membership, 2 visits/week (10/month)** | **$300/month** | **$30** |
| Membership, 3 visits/week (15/month) | $420/month | $28 |
| Unlimited membership | $540/month | As low as $18, depending on use |

So, **among these options, the two-visits-per-week membership is the best match for Ollie’s routine**; the three-visits-per-week and unlimited memberships can have a lower per-day cost if you’d actually use those extra visits. The 10- and 20-day packs are prepaid and non-refundable.

turns.customer: And if I bought a pack instead, can I get a refund for days I don't use?
blocks: No. The daycare packs are **prepaid and non-refundable**. The listed 10- and 20-day packs may be used one day at a time or all at once, but unused days aren’t refundable.
